title: 螺旋槳噪音量測
summary: 以「從麥克風校正到轉速同步頻譜建立螺槳噪音證據」為主線，在聲學合成波形與麥克風幾何台中依序完成轉速與葉片通過頻率、聲學訊號抗混疊、背景與多聲源能量、事件持續時間與聲曝露、位置及校正誤差合成及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Build propeller-noise evidence from microphone calibration to speed-synchronous spectra in a Synthetic acoustic waveforms and microphone geometry bench, progressing through Speed and blade-passage frequency, Acoustic anti-aliasing, Background and multiple-source energy, Event duration and exposure, Location and calibration uncertainty, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 轉速與葉片通過頻率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Speed and blade-passage frequency: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 轉速與葉片通過頻率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Speed and blade-passage frequency and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「螺旋槳噪音量測」中，本單元處理「轉速與葉片通過頻率」。每轉有B片槳掃過固定位置，因此主通過頻率是B乘每秒轉數；諧波不是新增轉子。
steps.instructionEn: Within Propeller-noise measurement, this unit examines Speed and blade-passage frequency. B blades pass a fixed point each revolution, so passage frequency is B times revolutions per second; harmonics do not imply extra rotors.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：葉片數 B=4、轉速 n=1800 rpm。關係式 fBPF=Bn/60；含輸出單位換算的算式 4*1800/60，結果 120 Hz。適用範圍：定轉速頻率定位，不預測噪音幅值或人體暴露。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Blade count B=4 and speed n=1800 rpm. Relation fBPF=Bn/60; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 4*1800/60 gives 120 Hz. Applicability: Constant-speed frequency location, not noise amplitude or exposure prediction.
steps.failure: 在「轉速與葉片通過頻率」的情境中，轉速變動造成頻譜展寬，不能單憑寬峰認定多個故障源。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Speed and blade-passage frequency, Speed variation broadens peaks and does not alone prove multiple faults.
steps.check: 針對「轉速與葉片通過頻率」，把轉速訊號與頻譜並排，檢查峰值是否隨轉速同比例移動。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Speed and blade-passage frequency, Compare tachometer data with spectra and test proportional frequency shifts. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.text: 只把 n 改為2100 rpm，其餘條件固定。用 4*2100/60 重算，結果從 120 變成 140 Hz。先預測方向，再記下對「轉速與葉片通過頻率」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。

Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Speed and blade-passage frequency, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.
